entities.summary: Perseo Miranda (b. 1965-04-15, Genoa) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Genoa and Italy. Known in the fields of italy, composers & musicians, europe.
